name: Numeric latch
description: Captures a numeric input value on a pulse and holds it internally. The captured value is sent to the output on trigger or optionally on capture.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: The numeric input value available for capture.

inputs.name: Capture
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge latches the current input value internally. If 'Trigger on capture' is enabled, also sends the value to the output.

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge sends the captured value to the output, even if the output already holds the same value.

inputs.name: Reset
inputs.description: Pulse input. Rising edge resets the output and captured value to the configured default value. Dominant input.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.description: The latched numeric value. Updated on trigger, on capture when auto-trigger is enabled, or on reset.

config.name: Default value
config.description: The value restored to the output and captured state on reset.

config.name: Trigger on capture
config.description: When enabled, capturing a value also immediately sends it to the output. When disabled, capture only stores the value internally until an explicit trigger.

state.name: Captured value
state.description: Holds the internally captured numeric value.

state.name: Previous capture state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the capture input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous trigger state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the trigger input to detect rising edges.

state.name: Previous reset state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the reset input to detect rising edges.
